name: college-complaint-box
description: College Complaint Management System - Full Stack Web Application

scripts.setup: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.dev: npx --yes concurrently "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.users: node -e "const sqlite3 = require('./server/node_modules/sqlite3'); const db = new sqlite3.Database('./server/complaints.db'); db.all('SELECT id, name, email, role, student_id FROM users', (err, rows) => console.table(rows));"
